conbody.p: The Highway Lane Change Assist status is visible on the instrument cluster. For more information, refer to .
The Highway Lane Change Assist status is displayed on the instrument cluster as follows:

li.p: White () blinking: Canceled (displays for a short time after cancellation)
The lane line displays with the same color as the Highway Lane Change Assist indicator (1). However, the lane detection availability is shown on Standby.
The green arrow appears when a certain amount of time has passed after the function starts operating and until the lane change is completed.
A message appears if Highway Lane Change Assist cannot operate when you use the turn signal lever.
A message appears when Highway Lane Change Assist is canceled while operating.

conbody.p: To turn Highway Lane Change Assist on, use one of the following methods:

li.p: Turn on Highway Driving Assist by operating the corresponding switch or button. The Highway Lane Change Assist function will be activated simultaneously.
Press OK when a prompt asking whether to use the Highway Lane Change Assist function appears on the cluster.
